title: Do not recommend! Better off to buy a timer with a keypad to set time.
text: Do not recommend! Better off to buy a timer with a keypad to set time.. Timer not accurate. Timer very difficult to set. Trying to change time buy one minute will cause it to jump 1 hour and 30 minites or more. Reset buttons are located on the sides which is where you would normally grab the timer to move it on your counter. Unable to set seconds, only full minutes. The timer failed after only 6 months and went into the garbage.

product_metadata.title: AcuRite Digital Twist Timer, Multicolor
features: 360 degree click wheel rotates to set the time
Counts up or down to/from 9 hours, 59 minutes, 59 seconds
Brushed stainless steel accent fits nicely into any kitchen or classroom
Stays positioned in place for one-handed use with anti-slip base
description: If you've spent any time in the kitchen, you've probably wished you had more than two hands. With this in mind, it helps to use kitchen products that are easy and seamless to operate. The AcuRite Rotary Digital Timer is a thoughtfully-designed twist timer that enables effortless, one-handed use. Easily set the timer to count up or count down simply by rotating the dial. A firm grip base holds the timer in place during use. Other features include a bold, easy-to-read kitchen timer display and oversized buttons to start, stop and clear the time. Maximum timer range is 9 hours 59 minutes 59 seconds. A loud alarm sounds when time is up. Attractive brushed stainless steel accent. Powered by 1 AAA alkaline battery (not included). One-year limited warranty. It's more than accurate, it's AcuRite.
